ios.desc:
Transform your posture and boost your productivity with UpRight the revolutionary app that turns your AirPods into a personal posture coach.

Why UpRight?
Poor posture affects 80 % of people, leading to chronic pain, reduced energy, and lower confidence. UpRight uses the motion sensors in your AirPods to monitor head and neck alignment in real time, gently reminding you to stay upright throughout the day.

Key Features (Subscription Required):
Smart Posture Tracking
	•	Real-time monitoring via AirPods motion sensors
	•	Alerts only after sustained slouching
	•	Adjustable sensitivity and notification options

Posture Score & Analytics
	•	Live posture score (0 – 100)
	•	Daily and weekly progress dashboards
	•	Clear visual trends and insights

Gamified Workouts
	•	Quick 5–10 minute correction routines
	•	Streaks to build consistency
	•	Unlockable achievements as you improve

App-Blocking Motivation
	•	Optional locking of distracting apps 
	•	Unlock by completing a short posture workout
	•	Encourages healthy habits

Seamless Integration
	•	Runs quietly in the background
	•	Minimal battery impact
	•	No extra hardware required

Beautiful Design
	•	Clean, intuitive interface
	•	Real-time 3D visualization of your posture
	•	Full dark-mode support


Perfect For
	•	Remote workers and office professionals
	•	Students studying for long hours
	•	Anyone experiencing neck or back discomfort
	•	Health-conscious individuals seeking better posture


How It Works
	1.	Put on your AirPods.
	2.	Complete a 5-second calibration.
	3.	UpRight monitors your posture.
	4.	Receive gentle reminders to straighten up.
	5.	Track your progress and build lasting habits.


Privacy First

All motion data is processed locally on your device; we never collect or store your personal movement data.

Requirements
	•	AirPods (3rd generation), AirPods Pro, or AirPods Max
	•	iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later

Pricing:
- $24.99/year ($2.08/month) with a 3-day free trial
- $4.99/week


Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/uprightpolicy/home

Start your journey to better posture today your future self will thank you!
